title.zh-CN: 必须验证服务器主机密钥
title.en-US: Server host key verification is required

body.zh-CN: 请填写 SSH 主机密钥的 SHA256 指纹。SForum 不会接受未知主机密钥。
body.en-US: Provide the SSH host key SHA256 fingerprint. SForum does not accept unknown server keys.

description.zh-CN: 不要包含 sftp:// 或路径。
description.en-US: Do not include sftp:// or a path.

label.zh-CN: SSH 主机密钥 SHA256 指纹

description.zh-CN: 例如 SHA256:...，用于阻止中间人攻击。
description.en-US: For example SHA256:..., used to prevent man-in-the-middle attacks.

description.zh-CN: 可以留空并改用 SSH 私钥；留空会保留已保存的密码。
description.en-US: May be blank when using an SSH private key; blank preserves the saved password.

description.zh-CN: 完整粘贴私钥内容；密码和私钥至少填写一项。
description.en-US: Paste the complete private key; provide a password or a private key.

description.zh-CN: 仅用于解锁加密的 SSH 私钥。
description.en-US: Used only to unlock an encrypted SSH private key.

description.zh-CN: 附件对象会写入此目录下。
description.en-US: Attachment objects are stored under this directory.

description.zh-CN: 可选。留空时附件继续通过 SForum 内容接口访问。
description.en-US: Optional. Leave blank to keep serving attachments through SForum content APIs.

description.zh-CN: 验证网络、主机密钥和登录认证，不写入附件。
description.en-US: Checks network, host-key verification, and authentication without storing an attachment.
